title: Excluir fixtures de generación fija del recovery ordinario
mission: Prevent the allocator/compiler recovery lane from converting generation-fixed contention fixtures into next-generation ownership that cannot satisfy their acceptance criteria. Preserve visibility of unfinished fixed-generation evidence and normal recovery for retry-safe jobs. The fix must be semantic, not a hardcoded job-id blacklist.
definition_of_done: A machine-readable job/recovery semantic distinguishes fixed-generation contention fixtures from retry-safe next-generation work without matching specific job IDs.
portfolio-exclusive-job-pin-live-race-5-v1 is no longer offered as G000002+ ordinary recovery when its contract requires G000001 collision attempts.
Unfinished fixed-generation fixtures remain visible/actionable through a compatible route rather than disappearing silently.
Normal retry-safe jobs still enter next-generation recovery after the existing liveness cutoff.
Regression fixtures cover fixed-generation exclusion, unfinished evidence visibility, and ordinary recovery preservation.
No product /w, Current, Served or Human Accepted authority is promoted.
